newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Norilsk flagship plant boosts Jan-Feb output yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Norilsk flagship plant boosts Jan-Feb output yr/yr.

text.p: The flagship plant of Russia's Norilsk Nickel metals group boosted nickel output 2.7 percent in January-February compared to year-ago levels, Interfax news agency said on Monday.
It gave no absolute production figures but said the level was 0.3 percent above targeted levels.
The plant's copper output over the first two months rose 3.6 percent year-on-year, cobalt production was flat and ore mining increased 11 percent.
The plant, the Norilsk mining and metallurgical combine, is part of RAO Norilsky Nickel.
The Norilsk group accounts for 85 percent of Russia's total nickel production. The flagship plant accounts for more than half of the group's nickel output.
State Statistics Committee figures earlier this month put Russia's total January-February nickel output at one percent below year-ago levels.
